# Data Directory

This directory contains all local data assets for the AI Incident Copilot:

```
data/
├── runbooks/           # 20 Markdown incident runbooks (Phase 2.1)
│   ├── redis_gil_lock.md
│   ├── cache_stampede.md
│   └── ... (20 total)
├── seed.py             # SQLite seeding script with injected anomalies (Phase 2.3)
├── mock_deploys.json   # Mock GitHub deploy history API (Phase 2.4)
├── incident_db.sqlite  # Generated by seed.py — gitignored
└── chroma_db/          # Generated by RAG pipeline — gitignored
```

## Generated Files (Not in Git)

- `incident_db.sqlite` — Created by running `python data/seed.py`
- `chroma_db/` — Created by running `python rag/pipeline.py --index`

Run `python data/seed.py` to populate the database before starting the agent.
